name: talkies
description: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible speech API — ASR and TTS over HTTP, live ASR over WebSocket, and ASR plus file staging over MCP.

url.title: talkies URL
url.description: Base URL of your running talkies server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (same value as TALKIES_URL).

authToken.title: talkies auth token
authToken.description: Bearer token. Only needed if the server was started with TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN set.
